subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / air-gap constraints
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acmehealth.com>; Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / air-gap constraints

Hi Sonia / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view.

Summary of needs / drivers you shared:
- Regulatory: PHI residency requirement for a subset of workloads; auditing & retention controls required by your legal/compliance team.
- Network: Air-gapped orchestration for ingestion pipelines is a potential requirement for your offline clinical models; need diagram of allowed egress (if any) and ops connectivity for updates.
- Security: KMS/HSM integration and SOC2 evidence are gating items for procurement.
- Scale: Peak inference for the private VPC will initially be ~100 concurrent sessions, spikes up to ~250 (5–10 TPS), with longer sequence lengths for clinical notes.

What Redwood proposes (high level):
1) Private VPC deployment inside AcmeHealth cloud account with VPC peering and optional transit gateway.
2) Air-gap option: customer-managed bastion and pull-only package for model updates; our private control plane can be run in your VPC or via an on-prem agent depending on compliance.
3) Security integrations: KMS support and audit logs; we'll surface evidence for SOC2 controls and onboarding checklist.

Open questions we need from you to scope & pricing:
- Confirm whether any outbound internet access is allowed for the inference cluster (yes/no + permitted IP ranges).
- Share the network diagram showing segmentation between clinical systems and the inference VPC.
- Who is the procurement contact / timeline for legal review?

Next steps (proposed):
1) Rishi and Dylan to prepare an initial architecture + rough TCO for the private VPC and air-gap options (deliverable: 1 pager + cost ranges) — target by Wed 3/31.
2) Sonia to share network diagram and procurement contact by EOW 4/2.
3) Follow-up technical working session with Acme networking and security (Dylan to lead) — propose week of 4/5.

Attachments: acmehealth-network-diagram.pdf (placeholder, please replace with your actual diagram), redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf, redwood-private-airgap-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I captured this in HubSpot and will attach the architecture notes after Rishi/Dylan share.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0104

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the high-level items are accurate. A few clarifications: 

- Outbound connectivity: for our regulated clusters we do not allow outbound internet egress. The only exceptions are updates from verified vendor endpoints via a controlled bastion (pull model).
- Network diagram: attaching a redacted internal network diagram (will send full version to procurement separately).
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com is the main contact; legal review will likely take 3–4 weeks.

We are keen to see the architecture & cost ranges. Can Rishi include an option for a fully air-gapped deployment (no internet egress) and a variant with restricted pull updates? Also please include any SLA differences for the air-gapped option.

Tom — looping you for any compliance comments.

Thanks,
Sonia

Marissa / Laura — I'm putting together two cost scenarios:
1) Private VPC with restricted pull updates (bastion-based) — lower ops overhead, partial remote updates.
2) Fully air-gapped with on-prem update media and manual rollouts — higher NRE and monthly ops premium.

A few asks to make the estimate accurate:
- Can Sonia confirm expected peak sustained token throughput and average sequence length? She mentioned longer clinical notes; a sample (anonymized) QPS/seq-length distribution would help.
- Any preferred GPU family or hard constraint on model size? If they require a quantized 8-bit profile vs FP16 that impacts instance choices.

I'll draft the architecture diagram and cost delta by EOD Wed (3/31). Laura — can you pull the current dedicated pricing bands and the one-time NRE template for air-gapped deployments?
